label: Blanc and Noir's Lucky Hot Spring

lines.text: A special event has occurred.
Participate in the event.
Go back.
After hearing that Blanc and Noir have prepared something special for us,
we all head towards the hot spring.
*Squeak*

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Welcome to the lucky hot spring!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Welcome to the lucky hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I'm Blanc.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: And I'm Noir. We'll be bestowing you with luck during your visit.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That was awesome.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: No wonder you two make such fine mascots for Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Your union is perfect.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Thank you all for your compliments!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: And thank you for giving us your precious time.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now, I'm sure everyone is curious as to what this event entails.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: You all know the legends of Snowfield that we've all been trying so hard to uncover?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There is one which states "Luck comes when ■■ enter the hot spring."

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Noir and I have been contemplating

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: what one would have to do in order to ensure that luck comes to you.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We ran through all the things that people most commonly associate with luck,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and we thought it might be money.
Money?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Tah-dah!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Do you see that basket floating on the water?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: You all can toss your coins into that basket,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and pray for good fortune to come your way.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm not too sure about this.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Is there any evidence that tossing a coin will bring about good luck?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We may not have much evidence,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but what we do have are Noir and I, the lucky bunnies!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We will be sharing some of our luck with anyone willing to toss a coin.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: How will that help us confirm whether the legends are true or not?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Are you sure that your luck can be shared like that?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Positive.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Our goal is to bestow luck upon all those we meet.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now, of course there are plenty of ways in which we can achieve that...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: But for today,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: we are going with the coin toss!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now, who wants to try first?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Me! Me!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Can I try?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Of course you can.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Step right up.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Woohoo!
Mica excitedly stands in front of the hot spring.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Er... out of curiosity,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: what happens if the coin doesn't go in the basket?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Then you'll have to keep at it until it does.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Luck isn't always so easy to obtain, after all.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That's true...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hyah!
Mica steadies herself, and tosses the coin.
*Clank*

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Impressive!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Booyah!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: On my first try, baby!
Maybe because of all that time you spent skipping stones.
I think you've got plenty of luck on your side already.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I think so too!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hehe, I feel so proud of myself.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I think you're right.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Maybe that legend you two are talking about is true!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now then, Mica.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Close your eyes, nice and tight.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Put your hands together.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: And pray for luck to come to you.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Gotcha!
Mica holds her hands together and closes her eyes.
A few moments pass.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That was probably enough.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Do you feel the luck coursing through your body?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: To be honest, I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I will say that I feel really good, though!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Well, that's good.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Even if it's not immediately apparent, I'm sure plenty of good things will happen for you.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I think so too! Thanks!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now, who's next?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Who's our next lucky individual?
After a moment of initial hesitation,
I sheepishly raise my hand.
I'll do it.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Pit Boss it is!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Please step forward.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Whenever you're ready,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: go ahead and throw the coin inside the basket.
I psych myself up,
and aim the coin at the basket.
Throw it forcefully.
Throw it lightly.
If I throw it with a bit more oomph, I might get more luck.
I attempt to channel all of my strength into the hand which is holding the coin,
wind up, and then give it a mighty hurl.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Wait, if you throw it like that...!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: P-Pit Boss!
*Plunk*

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That never stood a chance of going in.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Don't be discouraged, though!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Just ease up a little and I'm sure it will go in.
Despite my disappointment,
I relax my arm and give it another try.
*Clank*

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There we go!
If I get too crazy with it, the coin will bounce straight out.
I relax my arm
and give a gentle toss.
*Clank*

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Very nice!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: You did it on your first try as well!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Now then, close your eyes and put your hands together.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Then you can receive all the luck that's coming your way.
Following Noir's instructions, I close my eyes.
Slowly, all my distractions fade away,
and in the midst of my newfound calm, someone's face appears.
It's...
Blanc.
Noir.
Emma.
Ludmilla.
Mica.
The lucky white bunny.
In stark contrast to her usual attire, she is clad in an all-black yukata.
In the background is Snowfield Hot Spring, and in the foreground is her bright and bubbly smile.
Just looking at it brings a smile to my face.
I long to see that smile in person again.
I open my eyes ever so slightly,
and find my gaze meeting with Blanc's.
Blanc seems a bit surprised,
and gives me a warm smile in response.
I get a prickly sensation throughout my body,
and feel as though we've somehow become closer.
The lucky black bunny.
In stark contrast to her usual attire, she is clad in a half-white yukata.
As modest and self-conscious as ever, even ordinary words and compliments make her go beet red.
I remember the times when she stared into my eyes bravely,
and I find myself longing to glimpse into those expressive eyes in person.
I open my eyes ever so slightly,
and find my gaze meeting with Noir's.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Oh...
Noir's eyes widen in surprise,
before she averts her gaze, her cheeks flushing crimson.
Before long, she tentatively glances back at me.
I get a prickly sensation throughout my body,
and feel as though we've somehow become closer.
Emma, who embraces everyone with her gentle strength.
While her cheerful laughter makes her appear lighthearted and frivolous,
she also exudes a remarkable inner resolve.
Longing to see her smile,
I open my eyes,
and find my gaze meeting with Emma's.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hehehe...
Emma gives me a subtle nod
and covers her mouth with her hand as she lets out a soft chuckle.
I get a prickly sensation throughout my body,
and feel as though we've somehow become closer.
Ludmilla, my queen.
Although she may appear so elegant that she's out of reach,
her inner warmth is decidedly at odds with this frosty season.
I long for the warmth that she exudes, like a balmy spring day.
I open my eyes,
and find my gaze meeting with Ludmilla's.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmmm.
For a moment, Ludmilla's eyes widen ever so slightly,
before changing back to her usual composed expression.
I get a prickly sensation throughout my body,
and feel as though we've somehow become closer.
Mica, who is so affectionate and innocent.
There are times when I gaze into her eyes
where I feel like a speck of dust.
Longing for that innocence,
I open my eyes,
and find my gaze meeting with Mica's.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hehe.
Mica's eyes widen,
and she flashes a smile as she waves at me.
I can feel a wave of warmth surge through me,
and I feel as though we've somehow become closer.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Since you've opened your eyes.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Can you describe to us what you felt?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Pit Boss?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Do you feel the luck coursing through your body?
Yes. It feels wonderful.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That's fantastic!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That must mean that your luck has been replenished!
That it has. Thanks to you two.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hehe, don't mention it.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now, who's up next?
Eventually, everyone who had come to Snowfield threw a coin at the lucky hot spring.
Some were unsure.
Some got into it.
Some felt the luck surge through them.
As I spent a charming afternoon at the hot spring surrounded by my friends,
I felt the luckiest of all.
Blanc and Noir's Lucky Hot Spring: END
